transfer is not atomic: debits account_from before crediting account_to, so a failure during credit can leave balances inconsistent
transfer does not normalize/validate amount as Decimal, so floats or incompatible numeric types can cause TypeError or precision/behavior surprises
compound_interest silently truncates fractional years and compounds_per_year via int(), changing financial results without warning
loan_payment silently truncates fractional months via int(), changing repayment calculations without warning
compound_interest allows negative principal while loan_payment rejects it, an undeclared inconsistent validation rule
fx_convert does not validate rate positivity or finiteness, allowing zero, negative, NaN, or infinite FX rates to produce invalid money amounts
